craft_notes: Sthāyin: no-more-body joy (the seal). Sanskrit first: four ablatives + negation → L4 keeps all four uncut line 1, seal line 2. Rows: row 2 (ablatives whole line 1 — never split the causes). Rupture: comma after foregone — causes done, seal stated. Close: end-weight on un-bodiedness (no flesh). Minimal pass: 'craving-free' for nairvāsanya (desirelessness sung); 'flesh put on' for vigrahagraha (body-grasp sung). Read aloud: from/from/from/from — none. Rejected: 'reincarnation' — killed: body-grasping kept (mechanism, not doctrine-word); splitting ablatives — killed.

lines: real-unreal roads cut — no flesh put on.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nairvāsanyāt svasaṃbodhāt tyāgād āśābhimānayoḥ / sadasatpadavicchedān na punar vigrahagrahaḥ

reads_against.argmap: From desirelessness, self-awakening, leaving hope-pride, cutting real-unreal — no more body-grasping.
c1_essence: Desirelessness, self-waking, no hope-pride, no real-unreal road: no rebirth.
